questions.question: After Israel crossed the Jordan River, what did the LORD tell twelve men to take up from the middle of the river?
Joshua said twelve stones from the Jordan River would be a sign for Israel. Who would one day ask what they mean?
When the priests carrying the ark of the LORD came up out of the Jordan, what happened to the river?

answers.text: The waters returned and overflowed the banks
The riverbed stayed dry until morning
The waters stood up in a heap again

questions.question: On the day Israel crossed the Jordan River, what did the LORD do for Joshua in the sight of all Israel?

answers.text: He gave him a new name
